review.note: Approved (agent-e0a3, W9 reviewer r3). Read: ProjectLibrary.tsx diff (toolbar = Start/Import/search/gear; .library-caption with Sort Dropdown + icon-button icon-grow reverse (arrow in aria-hidden span) + view toggle; prefs via useState(readLibraryPreferences) and changePrefs writing on every change; rows Edited then Added; empty state sentence + templateChoices buttons calling onCreate(id) and Import writing calling writingInput.click(), the same actions as the Start menu items), library.css additions (tokens --type-small 12px, --type-large 15px, --muted, --text), new libraryPreferences.ts/.test.ts, new tests/w9-projects-page.spec.ts. Storage key is folio.workspace.library; bad data falls back per field (unparseable, non-object, null, number, throwing storage all tested). Fail-first T274-fail-first.txt: 6 of 8 failed pre-change (the 2 passing were the empty-search and bad-prefs cases, expected). Fresh runs: npx vitest run src/libraryPreferences.test.ts src/derived -> 16/16; npx tsc -b exit 0; PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1445 npx playwright test w9-projects-page projects-screen hover-emphasis import accessibility appearance sidebar-search --output test-results/T274-review -> 90 passed, 8 skipped (sidebar-search opt-in screenshots), 0 failed; H3 un-hoverable 10 (cap 12). Rulings: (1) empty-state aria-labels 'Start a Blank project' etc. ACCEPTED: the name contains the visible word (label-in-name holds) and avoids exact-name clashes with the Start menu items. (2) Sort trigger faux bold on hover ACCEPTED: the plan's exemption parenthetical covers the icon-only controls; Sort is a text control and AGENTS.md forbids a second hover rule; at rest it is 12 px muted, not bold, no border. Owner may want to judge it in the hand check. (3) Caption row shown with no projects ACCEPTED: the plan does not forbid it and motion.spec relies on it. Hand check: P1.md steps 1-5.
